prompts.L1:
Please polish the following text to make it more eloquent and professional, keeping all original information unchanged:

The invention relates to a manual cutting tool (110), comprising two arms (112) hinged about an axis (X), each arm comprising a first portion (114) to enable said tool to be grasped by a user and a second cutting portion (116), said first and second portions being separated from one another by said axis, the second portions of the arms comprising cutting edges (118) that define a cross-sectional area (A) of an element to be cut, the tool being configured such that a hinge on the arms about said axis brings the cutting edges of the arms together and cuts said element. The invention is characterized in that it further comprises a member (130) for protecting the user, which is made of a transparent material, said member extending substantially in parallel with said cross-sectional area and covering same completely, and being flexible in a plane substantially perpendicular to said cross-sectional area.

outputs.L1: The invention relates to a manual cutting tool (110) comprising two arms (112) hinged about an axis (X). Each arm comprises a first portion (114), configured to enable a user to grasp the tool, and a second, cutting portion (116), the first and second portions being separated by said axis. The second portions of the arms comprise cutting edges (118) that define a cross-sectional area (A) of an element to be cut. The tool is configured such that pivoting the arms about said axis brings the cutting edges together, thereby cutting said element. The invention is characterized in that it further comprises a user-protection member (130) made of a transparent material, said member extending substantially parallel to and completely covering said cross-sectional area, and being flexible in a plane substantially perpendicular thereto.
outputs.L2: The disclosed device is a hand-operated cutter (110) formed by a pair of arms (112) pivotally connected along an axis (X). On opposite sides of the pivot, each arm has a user-gripping section (114) and a cutting section (116). The cutting sections include cutting edges (118) surrounding the cross-sectional region (A) of an object intended to be severed. Pivoting the arms around axis (X) causes these edges to converge and cut through the object. The device additionally includes a user-safety component (130) made from transparent material. This component fully overlays the cross-sectional region, lies substantially parallel to it, and can flex within a plane oriented substantially perpendicular to that region.
outputs.L3:
The invention relates to a manual cutting tool comprising two arms hinged to one another about a pivot axis. Each arm includes a first portion configured to be gripped by a user and a second portion configured to perform a cutting operation. The second portions include respective cutting edges that together define a cross-sectional cutting area corresponding to the cross-section of an element to be cut.

When the user pivots the arms about the axis by bringing the gripping portions toward one another, the cutting edges move together and cut through the element positioned within the cross-sectional cutting area. The tool further comprises a transparent protective member that completely covers this cutting area. The protective member is flexible in a plane substantially perpendicular to the cross-sectional cutting area, thereby providing protection while allowing the cutting operation to be observed.
outputs.L4:
The invention relates to a manual cutting tool comprising two arms connected by a hinge or pivot. Each arm includes a cutting portion, and the cutting portions are arranged so that their respective cutting edges move toward one another when the user closes the arms. In use, the cutting edges surround and cut an element positioned within the cutting area.

A transparent protective member is arranged adjacent to the cutting edges. The protective member extends substantially parallel to the cutting area and is dimensioned to cover the entire area in which cutting occurs. It therefore forms a barrier between the user and the cutting edges, reducing the risk of accidental contact and helping to contain cut fragments or debris.

Because the protective member is transparent, the user can continuously observe the element, the cutting edges, and the progress of the cut. This visibility facilitates accurate positioning of the tool and allows the user to verify that the element remains correctly aligned during operation.

The protective member is also flexible. As the arms and cutting portions move relative to one another, the member can bend or deform in a direction perpendicular to the cutting area without substantially obstructing operation of the tool. Its flexibility enables it to accommodate changes in the geometry of the cutting region while continuing to cover that region.

The resulting construction combines safety with ease of use. The guard protects the user without concealing the cutting operation, while its flexible configuration permits normal movement of the hinged arms and allows the cutting edges to close around the element.
outputs.L5:
**The Power of “The”**

“The” is one of the most frequently used words in the English language. Known as the definite article, it identifies a particular person, place, object, or idea. For example, “the book” refers to a specific book, while “a book” can mean any book.

Although it is only three letters long, “the” makes communication clearer and more precise. It helps listeners and readers understand that something is already known, unique, or especially important. This small word demonstrates how even the simplest elements of language can have a significant impact on meaning.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent abstract for a manual cutting tool with two hinged arms and a transparent, flexible safety guard covering the cutting area.
counterfactuals.output: A manual cutting tool includes first and second arms coupled by a hinge for movement between open and closed positions. At least one cutting member is supported by the arms and defines a cutting area in which a workpiece is severed as the arms move toward the closed position. A safety guard extends over at least a portion of the cutting area. The safety guard is formed from a transparent, flexible material that permits visual observation of the workpiece and cutting member while limiting user contact with the cutting area and containing cuttings or fragments. The safety guard is configured to flex during insertion, positioning, or cutting of the workpiece and to return toward a protective position after deformation. The guard may be removably or pivotably coupled to one or both arms to facilitate cleaning, replacement, and access to the cutting member.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.prompt: Describe an invention involving plier-like cutters whose cutting edges define the cross-section of the item being cut, with a user-protection member extending parallel to and fully covering that cross-section.
counterfactuals.output: The invention is a safety cutting tool with two pivoted, plier-like jaws. Each jaw carries a cutting edge, and when the jaws close, the edges together outline the cross-sectional shape of the workpiece being severed. A protective member is positioned adjacent to the cutting plane, extends parallel to it, and spans the entire outlined cross-section. This member shields the user from the newly cut end or from fragments propelled during cutting, while allowing the jaws to perform the cut.
counterfactuals.label: cf_2

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a formal patent-style summary based on these features: two arms hinged about an axis, gripping portions, cutting portions, opposing cutting edges, and a transparent protective member flexible perpendicular to the cutting plane.
counterfactuals.output: A hand-operated cutting tool includes first and second arms pivotably coupled about a hinge axis. Each arm includes a gripping portion configured to receive an applied manual force and a cutting portion having a cutting edge. The cutting edges are arranged in opposing relation and are movable relative to one another within a cutting plane in response to pivotal movement of the arms. A transparent protective member is disposed adjacent to at least one of the cutting portions to shield a user from cut material while permitting visual observation of the cutting operation. The protective member is flexible in a direction perpendicular to the cutting plane, thereby allowing resilient deflection during use.
counterfactuals.label: cf_3

counterfactuals.prompt: Convert the following concept into patent language with numbered reference signs: a manual cutter (110) having hinged arms (112), handles (114), cutting portions (116), edges (118), and a transparent flexible safety guard (130).
counterfactuals.output: A manual cutter (110) comprises a pair of arms (112) hingedly coupled to one another. Each arm (112) includes a handle portion (114) and a cutting portion (116), the cutting portions (116) defining respective cutting edges (118) configured to cooperate during movement of the arms (112). A transparent, flexible safety guard (130) is coupled to at least one of the arms (112) and extends adjacent to at least one cutting portion (116). The safety guard (130) is configured to limit user contact with the cutting edges (118) while permitting visual observation of a cutting operation and flexing in response to engagement with a workpiece.
counterfactuals.label: cf_4

counterfactuals.prompt: Generate a single-paragraph European patent abstract for a hand-operated cutting tool that closes around an element and includes a transparent guard covering the entire cross-sectional cutting area while remaining flexible out of that plane.
counterfactuals.output: A hand-operated cutting tool comprises first and second cutting members movable relative to one another between an open position for receiving an element to be cut and a closed position in which the cutting members close around and sever the element. A transparent guard is arranged adjacent to the cutting members and extends over substantially the entire cross-sectional cutting area defined by their closing movement, thereby shielding a user while permitting visual observation of the cutting operation. The guard is substantially stable in the plane of the cutting area and flexible out of said plane, allowing the guard to deflect during positioning and cutting of the element without materially obstructing operation of the tool.
counterfactuals.label: cf_5
